questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Liberia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Liberia article.

questions.proof: The capital city of Liberia is Monrovia.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Liberia?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Liberia on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Liberia article.

questions.proof: It has common borders with Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Ivory Coast.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Liberia?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Liberia article.

questions.proof: Its official language today is English .

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The United States did not recognize it as a country until _____.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the nineteenth century.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Liberia article, under the heading “History”.

questions.proof: The United States did not recognize it as a country until 1862.
